scientific_integrity: The proof is exact and self-contained. The upper bound is exhaustive for all three cyclic side vectors, and the constructions attain both branches. No finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to a square whose Minkowski origin lies on a diagonal. It does not classify off-diagonal origins or arbitrary asymmetric convex disks. A 2003 paper by the same authors was identifiable bibliographically but not materially inspectable in full text.
title: Exact diagonal-origin profile for equilateral triangles in a Minkowski square
